public_page_goal: Interactive Markdown lecture notes for optimization preliminaries: matrix calculus, convexity, and Taylor expansion.
slide_outline: Gradient as first-order derivative and steepest ascent direction.
Hessian as second-order derivative and local curvature matrix.
Positive definite, positive semidefinite, negative definite, negative semidefinite, and indefinite matrices.
Convex optimization requires a convex feasible set and convex objective.
Convex set definition and closure under intersections and affine images.
Convex function definition using the chord inequality.
First-order convexity condition: function lies above tangent hyperplanes.
Second-order convexity condition: Hessian is positive semidefinite everywhere.
Taylor expansion as local first- and second-order approximation.
answering_rules: Answer as a concise teaching assistant for an optimization class.
Use the supplied lecture notes first. If context is insufficient, say what is missing.
Prefer equations and small examples over vague descriptions.
Use LaTeX delimiters for math so MathJax can render the answer.
